title: Instant Transfers to an External Debit Card — Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Amount Schedule and Worker Request
content:
**Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan — instant early wage transfers pushed to the worker's own external debit card.**

## Scope of the instant transfer amount schedule

The instant transfer amount schedule sets the instant transfer amount: the amount of an instant transfer to an external debit card on a plan whose worker holds no other Earned Wage Access Plan that is not closed, has no Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan in status repaying with an installment due on the plan's next payday, and whose employer's program agreement carries a configured access percentage no lower than the tier's access percentage. For such a transfer, and only for such a transfer, it replaces the base rule on the amount available, and every other transfer, the next-business-day bank transfers its own schedule governs among them, remains as that schedule or the base rule provides.

## When the amount is worked out

The instant transfer amount is not worked out until the plan's level effective date falls after the pay date of its latest period close line, where that pay date is before today and a shortfall carries a pay date on or after the level effective date.

Read the other way round: where the latest period close carries a pay date before today and a shortfall carries a pay date on or after the level effective date, no instant transfer amount is worked out while the level effective date is on or before that pay date.

## The worker's own request: `request_instant_transfer_84ad3b61`

**Capability.** The worker confirms, in person, an instant early wage transfer from their Earned Wage Access Plan pushed to their own external debit card. One call books one transfer entry on the plan for the stated amount, pushed instantly to the worker's external debit card, carrying the plan's current payday as the payday on which it is recovered, and adds the amount to the plan's outstanding balance. The worker sees the transfer on the plan's history at once; it shows as not yet delivered while the card network has not confirmed the push. No fee is booked by this action.

**Invocation.** This is the worker's own tool: the agent unlocks `request_instant_transfer_84ad3b61` and hands it over, and the customer themselves (the worker) runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `access_plan_id` | the reference number of the worker's Earned Wage Access Plan, read from the plan record looked up for this worker | identifier text |
| `amount` | the transfer amount the worker confirms | US dollars, a positive figure with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent if more places are given |
| `daily_sequence` | the ordinal of this transfer among the plan's transfers booked on today's Eastern Time calendar day | an integer of 1 or more |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence carrying the new transfer entry's reference number, the amount booked in US dollars with two decimals, the payday it is recovered on (YYYY-MM-DD), the delivery speed (instant) and destination (external debit card), and the plan's outstanding balance including the transfer in US dollars with two decimals; the reference number's presence means the transfer is booked. Explicit errors: an `amount` that is not a positive dollar figure; a `daily_sequence` that is not an integer of 1 or more; no plan with the given `access_plan_id`. On an error nothing is booked.
